meaning:
μοιχός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for נָאַף ;]
an adulterer: Luk.18:11, 1Co.6:9, Heb.13:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men, extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like…
Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male…
Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
